assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept, photorealistic film visual-effects environment matte painting. Asset type: a static background plate for a cinematic animated lock screen, landscape 1920x1080. Faithfully evoke the first-contact chamber scenes in Denis Villeneuve's Arrival (2016): camera in the dark human observation room looking straight at an enormous clear glass partition, beyond it a vast pale fog-filled alien atmosphere. Low-key desaturated warm grey, taupe, dirty ivory, muted charcoal, subtle smoky sepia rather than blue or green. Bright diffuse milky backlighting through deep volumetric haze. Two immense seven-limbed heptapod silhouettes extremely faint in fog at far left and far right, immense organic trunks tapering into long hanging tentacles. Frame is mostly translucent luminous fog and empty glass; reserve central 45 percent as softly lit empty fog where a black circular ink logogram will be composited. Barely visible weathered glass, subtle reflection, dark low horizontal sill at bottom and deep shadows along top edge, cinematic 2.39:1 composition within a 16:9 image. Believable physically lit film still with fine-grained texture, immense scale and atmospheric perspective. No humans, no text, no letters, no symbols, no ink rings, no sharp mechanical UI, no bright orange or saturated colors. This is a reusable environment plate, not a poster.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated photorealistic cinematic VFX tentacle/hand sprite with genuinely transparent background for a scene inspired by the heptapods in Arrival (2016). One alien appendage only, no body, no face. A thick dark charcoal wrinkled tubular tentacle enters from the bottom left corner and curves upward and rightward into a splayed organic seven-fingered radial hand. Long tapering jointless fingers curl around a small central emitter mouth, asymmetrical unfurling gesture against a glass pane. Believable immense cephalopod flesh, deeply ridged elephant-like skin, subtle wet graphite highlights, dusky desaturated grey/taupe, fine organic surface detail, soft diffuse ivory backlight from upper right, fingers and trunk in silhouette with enough detail to see the wrinkles. The visible appendage occupies the lower left to upper middle of the square canvas, leave padding around the thin finger tips. No black ink cloud, no liquid, no lettering, no symbols, no circular rings, no scene background, no glass rectangle. Output a clean alpha cutout with detailed antialiased edges, opaque dark flesh and transparent surroundings.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: photorealistic VFX black ink emission sprite, genuine transparent background, for compositing behind an authentic film logogram on a clear glass pane. A small dense charcoal-black liquid jet enters from lower left and blooms toward upper right into long hair-thin fractal tendrils, smoke-like fluid wisps, branching capillary filaments and tiny dispersed droplets. The physics is ink injected into cloudy water, like the heptapod writing fluid in Arrival (2016). Graceful elongated curved plume, concentrated black source at lower left, dissipating delicate transparent grey edges to upper right. High-speed macro-fluid photography, cinematic side backlighting, extremely fine turbulence and organic flow, soft volumetric density, monochrome black and warm grey. Isolated fluid only, no hand, no tentacle, no background scene, no paper, no text, no glyphs, no complete rings or circles. Clean transparent alpha with wispy partially transparent edges. The silhouette must feel like liquid physically dispersing in air or water rather than a flat paint splash.
